story_text: As a user, I want to delete a task so that I can remove items I no longer need.

positive.title: Verify deleted task is no longer retrievable
steps: 3. Attempt to retrieve the deleted task

negative.title: Delete a non-existent task
steps: 1. Attempt to delete a task that does not exist

negative.title: Delete another user's task
steps: 1. Attempt to delete a task owned by another user

negative.title: Delete a task without authentication
steps: 1. Attempt to delete a task without being logged in

edge.title: Delete the same task twice
steps: 3. Attempt to delete the same task again
